the use of ICT tools in judicial cooperation is a key element of the future European Judicial Space, and that the development of secure ICT platforms, based on CSCW technologies, can improve the efficiency of judicial cooperation.
the use of secure ICT platforms can support judicial cooperation in crossborder investigation, by improving the quality of information and by increasing the efficiency of judicial cooperation.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new approach to international judicial cooperation, based on ICT and CSCW technologies, in order to improve the quality of the judicial cooperation and to support the work of judges and investigators in the process of cross border investigations.
the design of a new approach for judicial cooperation through secure information and communication technologies.

a new approach to judicial cooperation through secure ICT platforms is possible.

, the development of a secure ICT platform for judicial cooperation, based on a distributed and secure architecture, would be a great step forward to increase the efficiency of the judicial system and the security of European citizens.

the EU should promote the development of secure ICT platforms for judicial cooperation between Member State judicial systems, in order to increase the efficiency of judicial cooperation, and the security and the effectiveness of the judicial systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a system based on a secure ICT platform for cross border investigations could be the key to a more efficient and effective judicial cooperation between countries, in the fight against trans-national crimes.

the use of ICT infrastructures and CSCW tools can be a valuable tool to improve the efficiency of the judicial collaboration in cross border criminal investigations.
